title: Array statistics
description:
Read numbers into an array and report on them.

```
How many: 6
4 8 15 16 23 42
min 4, max 42, mean 18.00
above the mean: 23 42
reversed: 42 23 16 15 8 4
```
hints: An array parameter is really a pointer, which is why the length `n` must be passed too (lesson 2.04).
`reverse` swaps `a[i]` with `a[n - 1 - i]` for `i` up to `n / 2`.
requirements: Write `int min_of(const int a[], int n)`, `int max_of(...)`, `double mean_of(...)` and `void reverse(int a[], int n)`.
stretch: Add a `sort` function (insertion sort) and print the median.
